full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

actual_stored_projection_bodies.scope: All12 protocol fields, complete calculation/input/output, quality requirements/evidence, all measurement/property/unit bodies, source records, full row descriptions/amount evidence/basis/ranges, boundary/allocation/validation and reference fields. Literal and complete source/ancestor context checks are separate.

measurementRules.rule: Use Q newly first-quality-released complete net puzzle-set mass measured by cp_output_release; retained constituents and moisture once, packaging separate. Every normalized result refers to 1 kg of that same actual complete product.

Mass/kg constrains the reference denominator and actual mass exchanges only; energy remains MJ/kWh, gas/volume remains actual native volume, and time remains actual time. Physical V and burden A retain separate dimensions and a single final division.

Convert kWh to MJ once with 3.6 MJ/kWh. Volume-to-mass uses independently measured density for that substance and phase/T/P; cumulative volume is already integrated. Count-to-kg requires measured net set mass by actual configuration/conditioning; no fixed count, density, dimensions or secondary-property inference.

calculationRules.rule: Q = sum of measured net mass of newly first-quality-released complete sets; keep actual complete-set count and configuration masses as independent reconciliation. No packaging, prior FG or never-accepted rejected/destroyed samples in Q; already first-accepted later destroyed sets remain in original Q and their actual loss/disposition bridge.

For each exchange i: A_i = inherited assigned opening raw/WIP/unassigned-store vector + actual new attributable material/service/provider/work/treatment burden-addition vector before stock correction - genuinely unused/unassigned closing raw/WIP/store vector - justified transfer to a distinct other cohort/function. First-released closing FG is not a subtractable vector. Already stock-corrected consumption is not corrected again; ordinary scrap/sale/waste is not that other function.

b_i = A_i / Q exactly once after original-unit conversion and actual attribution. For performed original-cohort services use b_i_h = A_i_h / Qc exactly once with original measured Qc and observed H; only unused/unassigned service charge carries forward. Collection/aggregation/card descriptions refer to this single division and do not divide again. Q or Qc zero/missing yields no corresponding unit result, while actual raw loads remain.

g_i=V_i/Qanalysis is a diagnostic of the full actual physical event recorded once with declared positive observation basis. Actual linked model demand uses separate evidenced A_i/Q0_i or A_i_h/Qc for each original cohort in compatible provider units. Never repeat the full shared receiver/provider quantity for every cohort or shrink physical V by service shares; zero or unknown basis has no unit result.

calculationRules.applies_to: all physical stock and flow ledgers
calculationRules.rule: For each consistent gate: full wet opening stock + actual gross incoming = full wet closing stock + actual gross outgoing, including actual retained new repair matter/water; internal matched transfers cancel only after pair reconciliation. At manufacture Q already includes first-released closing FG, so FG stock belongs to the distinct service/FG gate, never add Q and its same closing FG twice. For each packaging pool include actual P/I/ER and S/EO/W plus separately measured water/repair legs; X_in/out removes same-side other duplicate terms only. Whole/constituent totals are disjoint or reconciled nonadditive views.

Convert raw units before attribution: 1 kWh = 3.6 MJ; mass/volume requires the actual substance measured density at recorded phase/T/P, not a secondary-property coefficient or water default. Integrate actual rates over their measured interval once; cumulative volume is already integrated. Keep elemental and H2O balances independent of actual-species accounting and reaction evidence.

Add separately named actual press, laminator, cutter, die-press, separator, bag-sealer and other physical assets if transacted during the horizon; no invented asset purchase when already installed. Whole/component supply coverage is disjoint or bridged/reconciled and internal installation/removal cancels. measurementRules.rule: Q为cp_output_release实测新增首次质量放行完整净套装质量，保留组分水一次、包装独立；全部归一化结果指同一真实完整产品的1 kg。
质量/kg仅约束参考分母及质量交换；能量仍为MJ/kWh、气体体积及时间按真实原生单位，物理V与负荷A维度独立，最终仅除一次。
kWh按3.6 MJ/kWh换MJ一次。质体换算用该物质独立实测相态温压密度，累计体积已积分；件数换kg须真实配置调湿下净套装实测，不推固定片数密度尺寸或次级属性。

calculationRules.rule: Q = 新增首次质量放行完整套装实测净质量之和；真实套数与各配置实测质量独立核对，Q不含包材、原FG或首次验收前拒收破坏试样；首次验收后破坏的套装仍在原Q并保留实际损失及处置桥。
每交换i：A_i = 已归属期初原料WIP未分配库继承向量 + 本期真实新增可归属材料服务供方作业处理负担向量（库存校正前） - 真正未用未分配期末原料WIP库向量 - 经论证向其他真实cohort功能转移。首次放行期末FG不得扣；已库存校正消耗不再校正，普通废料销售废物不是该其他功能。
原单位换算与真实归属后b_i = A_i / Q仅一次；原cohort已执行服务用原实测Qc及H令b_i_h = A_i_h / Qc仅一次，仅未用未分配服务负荷结转。采集汇总卡片均指同次除法，不再除；Q或Qc缺失为零则无对应单位结果但保留实际原始负荷。
g_i=V_i/Qanalysis仅为一次完整真实实物事件按声明正观察基准的诊断；实际链接模型需求另用各原批次有据A_i/Q0_i或A_i_h/Qc及相容供方单位。不得向每批重复完整共享接收/供方量，也不得按服务份额缩减实物V；零或未知基准无单位结果。
